nested_frame.facet: nested-state frame preservation: writing an attribute at path p changes no other (path, attribute) pair (parent attrs, sibling elements, unrelated subtrees all preserved) -- the property nested_state.sc checks by execution
nested_frame.statement:
theorem setAttrAt_frame : ∀ (p : Path) (st st' : St) (a : String) (x : Val),
    setAttrAt p st a x = some st' →
    ∀ (q : Path) (b : String), (q ≠ p ∨ b ≠ a) → getAttrAt q st' b = getAttrAt q st b :=

nested_add_attrs.facet: nested-state element creation preserves every attribute everywhere (a fresh element is empty, add_if_absent keeps an existing one with its attributes)
nested_add_attrs.statement:
theorem addElemAt_attrs : ∀ (p : Path) (st st' : St) (n : String) (v : Val),
    addElemAt p st n v = some st' →
    ∀ (q : Path) (b : String), getAttrAt q st' b = getAttrAt q st b :=

nested_remove_frame.facet: clearing an element at the state root keeps the root attributes and every sibling element (only the cleared element itself is affected)
nested_remove_frame.statement:
theorem removeElemAt_here_frame (st st' : St) (n : String) (v : Val)
    (h : removeElemAt .here st n v = some st') :
    st'.attrs = st.attrs ∧ ∀ (m : String) (w : Val), (m, w) ≠ (n, v) →
      lookup st'.elems (m, w) = lookup st.elems (m, w) :=
